likes.detail: Meredith Grey, Olivia Benson, and Benjamin Button. Benjamin was on her 2023 TIME Person of the Year cover
Born Dec 13. She calls it her lucky number and wrote it on her hand on tour
Grew up on a Christmas tree farm in Pennsylvania ('Christmas Tree Farm', 2019)
Her chai sugar cookies and homemade Pop-Tarts are well known among fans
Grey's Anatomy and Law & Order: SVU, which is where her cats' names come from
References to Dickinson, Rebecca, The Great Gatsby, and Peter Pan run throughout her catalog
folklore merch made the cardigan iconic
Holiday House in Watch Hill, the setting of her July 4th parties
A regular in the Arrowhead suite since September 2023

A fan tradition from the Eras Tour, kicked off by a 'You're On Your Own, Kid' bridge reference
Ownership of her work. She bought back her masters in 2025
